title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Baazi
desc: An honest officer is framed for murder when he starts investigating a case. However, he manages to escape from prison and goes undercover as a woman to unravel the conspiracy.

title: Rakto Nodir Dhara
desc: Jaga, an international terrorist, avoids a prison term of 21 years by killing multiple people involved in the case. However, the sons of his victims return to seek vengeance.

title: Noyonmoni
desc: Nayan's house catches fire after he is born, which makes people believe that he is a bad omen. His life changes drastically when his father is arrested.

title: Ekai Eksho
desc: Ratan, an honest autorickshaw driver, refuses to help a corrupt politician, Pradip Roy, which then leads to a local war. He also ends up falling in love with Jhilik, his daughter.

title: Kaali Aamar Maa
desc: Lakshmi's birth causes her mother's passing, yet Goddess Kali assumes a maternal role.
